title: Learn the coin's next-head probability
hook: Two stated cases: explore the Beta-Bernoulli predictive mean.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the Beta-Bernoulli predictive mean affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Mean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the Beta-Bernoulli predictive mean in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy coin has Beta(1,1) prior and independent data of 6 wins and 4 losses. What is the posterior predictive win probability?
